episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Ordinary teen Jenna Hamilton is thrust into the spotlight at school after a simple accident leads everyone to believe she attempted suicide in the series premiere.

episodes.title: Knocker Nightmare
episodes.summary: Mean girls Sadie and Lissa snap a nude photo of Jenna in the girls' locker room and send it to the entire school, eliciting some surprising reactions.

episodes.title: The Way We Weren't
episodes.summary: Matt invites Jenna to a party, making her wonder if he's ready to make their relationship public. Meanwhile, she also starts to realize that she might have more in common with Jake.

episodes.title: The Scarlet Eye
episodes.summary: Tamara becomes happily involved in her first sex scandal after contracting pink eye while making out in a hot tub. Also: Jenna tries to define her relationship with Matty.

episodes.title: Jenna Lives

episodes.title: The Adventures of Aunt Ally and the Lil' Bitch

episodes.title: My Super Bittersweet Sixteen
